0.11.5 is a patch of 0.11 and interoperates with 0.11.0 through 0.11.4: format epoch 7, backup format 5, protocol line `11` and every storage, wire and protocol format are unchanged, and the server, `ursulactl` and the extension change only their version. Nodes, gateways and extensions of 0.11.0 through 0.11.5 run in one cluster and open, read and import the same streams. Upgrade a cluster in place with an ordinary rolling restart (`helm upgrade`), and the SQLite client by installing `@tonbo/sqlite-ursula` 0.11.5. Rolling back to any earlier 0.11 release is safe.

- **Reads per stream in the gateway's usage export.** `ursulagw --usage-stream-reads <STREAMS>` (`UsageCollector::with_stream_reads`) adds `stream_reads` to each batch: per bucket, stream and class, the requests and response bytes of the reads whose upstream answered `2xx` or `304`, for at most `STREAMS` streams per window, with the rest counted in `stream_reads_unattributed`. Every read stays in its bucket's record. Counters only. Without the flag a batch keeps its earlier shape.
- **`UsageBatch` gains two public fields**, so code that builds one with a struct literal adds them.

Known issues: the known issues of 0.11.0 are unchanged. Every change is listed in the [0.11.5 release notes](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/release-notes#0115).
